[LADP.8.2.1] The compiler builds a service-dispatch table
from the `service` declarations of every library in the
compilation's import closure plus the rule file's own
declarations. Each entry maps a service name, the one global
name a call uses ([LGRA.10.1.6]), to its declaration
(kwarg shape and response schema reference). The table is emitted into the DSC alongside schema and
rule atoms; libds reads it at DSC load.
